sources.title: Horn Craft - Cuttack, Orissa: Anatomy of Bird or Animal
sources.publisher: NID Campus, Bengaluru; Dsource Digital Learning Environment for Design
sources.access: Original HTML making-process text directly read; original publisher19-page PDF downloaded and parsed through web tool. Full printed p9 visually inspected, with matching author/title/process text. PDF p5 tools text also read; other photographed pages not visually inspected by this researcher.
sources.integrity_note: Current HTML includes unrelated injected game links above the legitimate resource. No such links followed. Adopted process was checked against original linked PDF, which is preferred for the public source note. PDF is not independent corroboration of HTML.
sources.type: Primary institution-led workshop/process documentation, explicitly Cuttack; context and historical introduction vary in reliability.
locators: PDF p5 Tools and Raw Materials
supported_claims: In the documented Cuttack process, makers select and cut horn, shape it with files, and refine the surface by sanding and polishing.
For composite objects, individual parts are shaped and finished separately before being glued together.
The documented use of hollow horn for thin bird-wing parts illustrates material choice within that Cuttack account.
limits: Must explicitly locate this example in Cuttack. It is not direct observation of a Paralakhemundi workshop and cannot establish a universal Odisha sequence.
Publication/fieldwork date is not established. A related Dsource video is dated9April2018, but that does not date every statement or photo in the PDF.
Reject1892reign/origin anecdote, unchanged-process claim, present artisan-count/decline numbers, legal ownership/licensing claims, deer terminology and universal community attribution.
Do not turn the sequence into practical safety/procurement advice. No claims of recycled, ethical, cruelty-free or sustainable sourcing.
If a Dsource image is selected, its caption/alt/full credit and repeated brief description consume this same200-word family allowance; reduce process prose accordingly.
sources.media_rights: Coordinator's media agent must verify exact image credit and licence independently. This researcher has not cleared a particular photograph; no implication that a Cuttack photo shows Paralakhemundi.
